blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday said 234 school counselor associates were hired in Pangasinan to strengthen mental health and counseling services in public schools. He made the announcement during the mass oath-taking ceremony for newly promoted and newly hired Department of Education (DepEd) personnel in the province.
